::: {.callout-warning}
## Preview and Review Status

MLPerf EDU is not an official MLCommons benchmark and is not endorsed by
MLCommons. The current site is a reviewable project preview. Candidate result
labels, quality targets, and reference baselines remain subject to evidence,
dataset-policy, and MLCommons review. The component license and package-index
release are also open gates.
:::

::: {.hero-banner}
MLPerf EDU brings disciplined ML benchmarking into teaching and research. It
combines runnable workloads, declared scenarios and quality targets,
measurement controls, provenance, and reviewable artifacts in a laptop-first,
single-node suite. Core teaching models are white-box PyTorch modules that
students can inspect and modify.
:::

## Run the Checkout

The supported preview install uses the repository and its locked environment.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/harvard-edge/cs249r_book
cd cs249r_book/mlperf-edu
uv sync --locked --extra dev
uv run mlperf doctor
uv run mlperf health --output-dir submissions/first-health
```

No package-index release is published yet. The
[getting started guide](getting-started.qmd) covers a benchmark run and the
artifacts it produces. The [readiness page](readiness.qmd) separates the eight
target-passing workloads from measured gaps and blocked local quality paths.

## The Suite

{{< include _stats.qmd >}}

Browse the [benchmark registry](benchmarks/index.qmd). Benchmark pages are
generated from the same registry YAML that the harness reads. CI checks the
registry mirrors, review packets, generated pages, site render, and internal
links for drift.

## What the Profiles Mean

`min` is the fast functional path. `max` is the authoritative quality path,
and `pro` executes the research collection with preserved subrun evidence. A
`max` result becomes suitable
for citation only when its workload meets the declared quality contract, the
full release workflow passes, and the applicable dataset and public-result
policies are closed. The [running guide](guide/running.qmd) explains these
boundaries.

## Why It Exists

Official MLPerf suites set a high standard for benchmark governance and
measurement. They are also too operationally heavy for many classroom
settings. MLPerf EDU explores a smaller teaching and research layer while
keeping the artifacts needed for scrutiny. The [about page](about.qmd) covers
the design philosophy and the proposed MLCommons review path.
